description: A re-tuner for pitch voltages: it takes standard twelve-tone pitch in and gives back the same music in an equal division of any interval, on nine independent pairs of jacks

params.text: Stretches or compresses the whole tuning, -3% to +3%
Sets how many equal steps the interval is divided into, 1 to 99; the number appears on the display to the left of ed
Chooses the interval being divided, shown in yellow on the display: the ratios 9/8, 8/7, 7/6, 6/5, 5/4, 4/3 and 3/2, then the whole numbers 2 to 8 standing for that many times the frequency

inputs.text: A pitch to re-tune, one volt per octave; each semitone of what arrives becomes one step of the chosen tuning

outputs.text: The re-tuned pitch from the input beside it, one volt per octave

notes: a new module comes up dividing two octaves into 33 equal steps, which the maker calls 33ed4.
each output is only written while it is patched, and it takes its channel count from the input beside it, so an output with nothing on its own input carries nothing.
